description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceAuthStore Kotlin class in an Android application, utilizing Robolectric for testing Android components outside of an actual device or emulator.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStoreTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of DeviceAuthStore, including token persistence and legacy token reading.

methods.name: saveTokenPersistsNormalizedScopesMetadata
methods.description: Tests that saving a token with multiple scopes persists only the unique, normalized scopes along with role and token information.

methods.name: loadEntryReadsLegacyTokenWithoutMetadata
methods.description: Tests that the store correctly reads a legacy token stored without metadata, ensuring compatibility with older data.
